result.topic_en: A German-language argument in the foundations of the theory of parallels: it completes a proof that parallelism is transmitted to a further line, then sets out to prove that parallelism is reciprocal (if line 1 is parallel to 2, then 2 is parallel to 1) by a case analysis using congruent triangles.
